_doc: Two BR-V5 degradations on the DI families. `App` records a consuming ctor
LOCATION but no impl type, so both the message tail and the related label
degrade to the bare 'the constructor' / 'consuming constructor' rather than
guessing a name. `Head` has no registration line, so its captor hop is
skipped and the retention path emits ONE step — di_path_steps has no
'shorter than two steps' guard, unlike every other slice builder.
